title: Monte-Cristo's Daughter
author: Edmund Flagg
description: "Monte-Cristo's Daughter" by Edmund Flagg is a sequel to Alexandre Dumas' classic "The Count of Monte-Cristo," and it is a novel likely written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The story centers around Zuleika, the daughter of the iconic Count of Monte-Cristo, as she navigates her own tumultuous romantic life.

authorInfo.bio: Edmund Flagg (1815–1890) wrote Monte-Cristo's Daughter. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
